The name of the BackupDR backup to restore from.

The full path to the encryption key used for the CMEK disk encryption. Setting up disk encryption currently requires manual steps outside of Terraform. The provided key must be in the same region as the SQL instance.
Whether to enforce the new SQL network architecture.
The description of final backup if instance enable create final backup during instance deletion.
When this parameter is set to true, Cloud SQL instances can perform in-place major version upgrades of read replicas along with the primary instance when 'database_version' is updated.
The type of the instance. See https://cloud.google.com/sql/docs/mysql/admin-api/rest/v1/instances#SqlInstanceType for supported values.
The name of the instance that will act as the master in the replication setup. Note, this requires the master to have binary_log_enabled set, as well as existing backups.

The name of the instance. If the name is left blank, Terraform will randomly generate one when the instance is first created. This is done because after a name is used, it cannot be reused for up to one week.
For a read pool instance, the number of nodes in the read pool. For read pools with auto scaling enabled, this field is read only.
The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
The region the instance will sit in. Note, Cloud SQL is not available in all regions. A valid region must be provided to use this resource.
Initial root password. Required for MS SQL Server.
Initial root password. Required for MS SQL Server. Note: This property is write-only and will not be read from the API.
Triggers update of root_password_wo write-only. For more info see [updating write-only arguments](/docs/providers/google/guides/using_write_only_arguments.html#updating-write-only-arguments)
When set to true, Cloud SQL instances can switch storing point-in-time recovery transaction logs from a data disk to Cloud Storage, freeing up data disk space and enabling longer retention windows.
The name of the instance from which the point in time should be restored.
The name of the allocated ip range for the private ip CloudSQL instance. For example: "google-managed-services-default". If set, the cloned instance ip will be created in the allocated range.
(SQL Server only, use with point_in_time) clone only the specified databases from the source instance. Clone all databases if empty.
The timestamp of the point in time that should be restored.
(Point-in-time recovery for PostgreSQL only) Clone to an instance in the specified zone. If no zone is specified, clone to the same zone as the source instance.
The timestamp of when the source instance was deleted for a clone from a deleted instance.
The project ID of the source project
The Google Cloud Backup and Disaster Recovery Datasource URI. For example: "projects/my-project/locations/us-central1/datasources/my-datasource".
The name of the allocated IP range for the internal IP Cloud SQL instance. For example: "google-managed-services-default".
The date and time to which you want to restore the instance.
Point-in-time recovery of an instance to the specified zone. If no zone is specified, then clone to the same primary zone as the source instance.
The region of the target instance to restore to.
The name of the target instance to restore to.
PEM representation of the trusted CA's x509 certificate.
Specifies if a SQL Server replica is a cascadable replica. A cascadable replica is a SQL Server cross region replica that supports replica(s) under it.
PEM representation of the replica's x509 certificate.
PEM representation of the replica's private key. The corresponding public key in encoded in the client_certificate.
The number of seconds between connect retries. MySQL's default is 60 seconds.
Path to a SQL file in Google Cloud Storage from which replica instances are created. Format is gs://bucket/filename.
Specifies if the replica is the failover target. If the field is set to true the replica will be designated as a failover replica.
Time in ms between replication heartbeats.
Permissible ciphers for use in SSL encryption.
True if the master's common name value is checked during the SSL handshake.
If the instance is a primary instance, then this field identifies the disaster recovery (DR) replica. The standard format of this field is "your-project:your-instance".
If set, this field indicates this instance has a private service access (PSA) DNS endpoint that is pointing to the primary instance of the cluster.
The ID of the backup run to restore from.
The ID of the instance that the backup was taken from.
The full project ID of the source instance.
The machine type to use. See tiers for more details and supported versions. Postgres supports only shared-core machine types, and custom machine types such as db-custom-2-13312.
This specifies when the instance should be active. Can be either ALWAYS, NEVER or ON_DEMAND.
Enables Automatic Version Upgrade feature. Can be used with MySQL only.
The availability type of the Cloud SQL instance, high availability (REGIONAL) or single zone (ZONAL). For all instances, ensure that settings.backup_configuration.enabled is set to true.
The name of server instance collation.
Enables the enforcement of Cloud SQL Auth Proxy or Cloud SQL connectors for all the connections. If enabled, all the direct connections are rejected.
Allows using ExecuteSql API to connect to the instance. Disallowed when unspecified.
Provisioned number of I/O operations per second for the data disk. This field is only used for HYPERDISK_BALANCED disk types.
Provisioned throughput measured in MiB per second for the data disk. This field is only used for HYPERDISK_BALANCED disk types.
Configuration to protect against accidental instance deletion.
Enables auto-resizing of the storage size. Defaults to true.
The maximum size, in GB, to which storage capacity can be automatically increased. The default value is 0, which specifies that there is no limit.
The size of data disk, in GB. Size of a running instance cannot be reduced but can be increased. The minimum value is 10GB for PD_SSD, PD_HDD and 20GB for HYPERDISK_BALANCED.
The type of supported data disk is tier dependent and can be PD_SSD or PD_HDD or HYPERDISK_BALANCED.
The edition of the instance, can be ENTERPRISE or ENTERPRISE_PLUS.
Pricing plan for this instance, can only be PER_USE.
The acceptable replication lag, in seconds, after which a read replica recreates itself. The lag must persist for at least five minutes before recreation is triggered.

When this parameter is set to true, Cloud SQL retains backups of the instance even after the instance is deleted. The ON_DEMAND backup will be retained until customer deletes the backup or the project.
The time_zone to be used by the database engine (supported only for SQL Server), in SQL Server timezone format.
A set of key/value user label pairs to assign to the instance.
Domain name of the Active Directory for SQL Server (e.g., mydomain.com).
The secret manager key storing the administrator credential. (e.g., projects/{project}/secrets/{secret}).
Domain controller IPv4 addresses used to bootstrap Active Directory.
The mode of the Active Directory configuration. Can be MANAGED_ACTIVE_DIRECTORY or CUSTOMER_MANAGED_ACTIVE_DIRECTORY.
The organizational unit distinguished name. This is the full hierarchical path to the organizational unit.
The number of threads per physical core. Can be 1 or 2.
True if binary logging is enabled. If settings.backup_configuration.enabled is false, this must be as well. Can only be used with MySQL.
True if backup configuration is enabled.
True if Point-in-time recovery is enabled.
HH:MM format time indicating when backup configuration starts.
The number of days of transaction logs we retain for point in time restore, from 1-7. (For PostgreSQL Enterprise Plus instances, from 1 to 35.)
The unit that 'retainedBackups' represents. Defaults to COUNT
Whether Managed Connection Pool is enabled for this instance.
Whether data cache is enabled for the instance.
End date before which maintenance will not take place. The date is in format yyyy-mm-dd i.e., 2020-11-01, or mm-dd, i.e., 11-01
Start date after which maintenance will not take place. The date is in format yyyy-mm-dd i.e., 2020-11-01, or mm-dd, i.e., 11-01
Time in UTC when the "deny maintenance period" starts on start_date and ends on end_date. The time is in format: HH:mm:SS, i.e., 00:00:00
The application ID for the Entra ID configuration.
The tenant ID for the Entra ID configuration.
When this parameter is set to true, the final backup is enabled for the instance
The number of days to retain the final backup after the instance deletion. The valid range is between 1 and 365. For instances managed by BackupDR, the valid range is between 1 day and 99 years.
True if Enhanced Query Insights feature is enabled.
True if Query Insights feature is enabled.
Number of query execution plans captured by Insights per minute for all queries combined. Between 0 and 20. Default to 5. For Enterprise Plus instances, from 0 to 200.
Maximum query length stored in bytes. Between 256 and 4500. Default to 1024. For Enterprise Plus instances, from 1024 to 100000.
True if Query Insights will record application tags from query when enabled.
True if Query Insights will record client address when enabled.
The name of the allocated ip range for the private ip CloudSQL instance. For example: "google-managed-services-default". If set, the instance ip will be created in the allocated range.
The custom subject alternative names for an instance with "CUSTOMER_MANAGED_CAS_CA" as the "server_ca_mode".
Whether Google Cloud services such as BigQuery are allowed to access data in this Cloud SQL instance over a private IP connection. SQLSERVER database type is not supported.
Whether this Cloud SQL instance should be assigned a public IPV4 address. At least ipv4_enabled must be enabled or a private_network must be configured.
The VPC network from which the Cloud SQL instance is accessible for private IP. For example, projects/myProject/global/networks/default. Specifying a network enables private IP.
Specify how the server certificate's Certificate Authority is hosted.
The resource name of the server CA pool for an instance with "CUSTOMER_MANAGED_CAS_CA" as the "server_ca_mode".
Settings for how the server certificate gets rotated.
Specify how SSL connection should be enforced in DB connections.
The RFC 3339 formatted date time string indicating when this whitelist expires.

The name of the instance. If the name is left blank, Terraform will randomly generate one when the instance is first created. This is done because after a name is used, it cannot be reused for up to one week.
List of consumer projects that are allow-listed for PSC connections to this instance. This instance can be connected to with PSC from any network in these projects.

Name of network attachment resource used to authorize a producer service to connect a PSC interface to the consumer's VPC. For example: "projects/myProject/regions/myRegion/networkAttachments/myNetworkAttachment".
Whether a service connection policy is created for the auto connections configured for the instance.
Whether PSC auto DNS is enabled for this instance.
Whether PSC connectivity is enabled for this instance.
Whether PSC write endpoint DNS is enabled for this instance.
The consumer network of this consumer endpoint. This must be a resource path that includes both the host project and the network name.
The project ID of consumer service project of this consumer endpoint.
A Google App Engine application whose zone to remain in. Must be in the same region as this instance.
The preferred Compute Engine zone for the secondary/failover
Day of week (1-7), starting on Monday
Hour of day (0-23), ignored if day not set
Receive updates after one week (canary) or after two weeks (stable) or after five weeks (week5) of notification.
Whether the password policy is enabled or not.
Disallow username as a part of the password.
Minimum interval after which the password can be changed. This flag is only supported for PostgresSQL.
Number of previous passwords that cannot be reused.
True if auto scale in is disabled.
True if Read Pool Auto Scale is enabled.
Maximum number of nodes in the read pool. If set to lower than current node count, node count will be updated.
Minimum number of nodes in the read pool. If set to higher than current node count, node count will be updated.
The cooldown period for scale in operations.
The cooldown period for scale out operations.
Metric name for Read Pool Auto Scale.
Target value for Read Pool Auto Scale.
The name of the destination bucket (e.g., gs://mybucket).
How long to keep generated audit files. A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, terminated by 's'. Example: "3.5s"..
How often to upload generated audit files. A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, terminated by 's'. Example: "3.5s".
The name of the Cloud SQL instance. Changing this forces the script to be run on the new instance.
The SQL script to provision database resources. Its execution time limit is 30 s. Changing this forces the script to be rerun. Make sure the script is idempotent.
The name of the database to which Terraform connects. Changing this forces Terraform to connect to the new database and run the script. This argument is required for Postgres instances.
The deletion policy for the resources created by the script. The default is "ABANDON". It must be "ABANDON" to allow Terraform to abandon the resources.
The description of the provision script.
The resource name of the Secret Manager secret storing the password. The secret should be a regional secret and stored in the exact same region as the Cloud SQL instance.
The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
The name of the built-in database user to authenticate as. For MySQL user, omit '@' and the hostname. The user should exist as a built-in user in the database.

The MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server (beta) version to use. Supported values include MYSQL_5_6, MYSQL_5_7, MYSQL_8_0, MYSQL_8_4, POSTGRES_9_6, POSTGRES_10, POSTGRES_11, POSTGRES_12, POSTGRES_13, POSTGRES_14, POSTGRES_15,…
The IPv4 address and port for the external server, or the the DNS address for the external server. If the external server is hosted on Cloud SQL, the port is 5432.
The name of the source representation instance. Use any valid Cloud SQL instance name.
